title: Met police launch investigation into David Walliams allegations
summary_full: Police say allegations of sexual misconduct are separate from those made by multiple women in Guardian and ITN investigationThe Metropolitan police have announced a criminal investigation into David Walliams over alleged sexual misconduct.In reports by the Guardian and ITV News, Walliams, 55, has been accused by multiple women of using his power and celebrity status to prey on young women and teenagers for sex.
